# Anontalk

> Anonymous live chat with real people. Private, discreet, no subscription. New accounts get 5 free messages; after that each message you send costs 1 credit and replies are always free.

Anontalk.online is a 100% private and anonymous chat platform. Visitors pick a chat partner profile, start a conversation in the browser and stay anonymous throughout: only an alias is shown. Chat partners are warm, everyday people, not therapists or medical professionals.

- [Homepage](https://anontalk.online/)

## Site Features and User Interaction

- Anonymous live text chat, no identifying information required
- Sign-up needs only an email and an alias
- 5 free messages on the first chat, no credit card required
- You pay per message you send; chat partner replies are free
- Choose your chat partner from public profiles; real people, not therapists
- Chats run in the browser and are never shared with third parties
- No subscriptions and no long-term commitments

## Payments and Credits

- Credits are sold in bundles; the price per message drops with larger bundles
- Prices are shown in US dollars and paid through Stripe
- Payments appear as "HELP & SUPPORT DESK" on bank and card statements
- Credits never expire

## Frequently Asked Questions

- Is it really anonymous? Yes: only your alias is visible to your chat partner.
- Are chat partners professionals? No, they offer everyday perspective, not professional advice.
- How do the 5 free messages work? Every new account gets them on the first chat.
- How am I billed? 1 credit per message you send; replies are free.
- Who can see that I chatted? Nobody; the billing descriptor is neutral.
- Do credits expire? No.
